text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 431 million markka median
forecast for confectionery and packaging materials group
Huhtamaki Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items
and tax:
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 431 10.70
Lowest 339 9.80
Highest 492 13.60
(Profit forecasts by 18 analysts, EPS by 15 analysts).
Huhtamaki's results are due on Feb 11 at 0900/0700 GMT.
In 1995, Huhtamaki posted a 312 million markka profit
before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 13 of the 18
analysts polled gave a median forecast of 550 million markka
(mean 558 million) in a 390-680 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Den Danske
Bank, Erik Serlin, Evli Securities, FIM Securites, FSB
Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita
Bank, Opstock, Paribas, Postipankki and S-E Banken.
